question: Do exactly identical idealized CompaSO-like L1 mass, SO radius, mean-density threshold and redshift uniquely determine M200c? Construct two positive monotone spherical profiles that share those external values but have different M200c, then specify fail-closed conditions for future real Abacus headers/merger trees without accessing them now.

official_sources.evidence: L1 N particle mass, SO_radius possible special non-crossing value, epoch SODensityL1 relative mean, 10 percent RV+PID at primary, secondary z0.95 approximate and only halo-info+PID, actual redshift header, POSIX cksum in checksums.crc32.
L0/L1 competitive spherical-overdensity group definitions, threshold varies with epoch; N is L1 membership and SO_radius is not 200 critical radius.
Official c000 h=.6736, omega_b=.02237, omega_cdm=.12, omega_ncdm=.00064420, smooth-neutrino IC/growth; use actual header over public table for a real dataset.
Provider first release and cleaned catalogs have distinct persistent identifiers; actual c000 tree product and exact box/version/files not verified in this stage.

synthetic_scope.background: Analytic FLAT matter+Lambda toy Omega_m0=(omega_b+omega_cdm+omega_ncdm)/h^2, E2=Omega_m0*(1+z)^3+1-Omega_m0, Omega_m_z=Omega_m0*(1+z)^3/E2. This ignores radiation and nuanced massive neutrino evolution. The actual mean density convention of an Abacus ASDF header is NOT inferred from this toy.
synthetic_scope.two_models: For p in {1,2}, enclosed M_p(r)=M_L1*(r/R_L1)^p inside R_L1, M_L1 outside. For 0<r<R_L1 the positive integrable density is p*M_L1*r^(p-3)/(4*pi*R_L1^p). Exactly identical M_L1,R_L1 and synthetic mean SO threshold at R_L1.
synthetic_scope.target: For synthetic total matter mean, Delta200c_in_mean=200/Omega_m_z. Since illustrative DeltaL1_mean=200<Delta200c_mean, x=r200c/R_L1=(DeltaL1_mean/Delta200c_mean)^(1/(3-p)), M200c/M_L1=x^p. Reclose 200 critical mean density exactly.
synthetic_scope.strict_caveat: Even stronger idealized perfect L1 SO crossing leaves M200c underdetermined from mass/radius alone. This is NOT a real Abacus halo, not a claim that ALL halo_info fields or actual complete particles are insufficient, not an actual measured SODensityL1 value. Real SO_radius may use sentinel when crossing absent.

next_real_data_gate_not_executed.accession: Separate prereg/approval before any real halo file; provider persistent DOI, c000 box+phase, raw/cleaned product, version, actual path, provider POSIX/GNU cksum and locally computed SHA256. Provider checksums.crc32 must not be assumed to equal zlib.crc32.
next_real_data_gate_not_executed.exact_epoch: Read actual per-file ASDF redshift and cosmology. Directory z0.95 is only approximate; do not treat original E17A z=.945,.950,.955 as actual Abacus times.
next_real_data_gate_not_executed.actual_mass: Read ParticleMassHMsun, N, SODensityL1 and species/reference density/units from actual header; detect SO_radius non-crossing special value. Do not rename N*ParticleMassHMsun or SO_radius to M200c. For M200c demand validated same-epoch 200*rho_crit remeasurement with sufficient full halo+field radial inventory, periodic padding and center OR independently validated provider M200c with provenance; sparse subsamples and secondary PID-only are insufficient for exact mass.
next_real_data_gate_not_executed.actual_tree: Actual halo branch, cleaning/raw consistency, per-epoch mass definition, progenitor and descendant IDs, exact epoch and checksum are mandatory before claiming M200c(a).
next_real_data_gate_not_executed.original_neutrino: c000 smooth neutrino CDM-only N-body and original nonthermal E8 F+/F- are distinct; neither actual halo tree nor its mass history is a self-consistent neutrino wake.
next_real_data_gate_not_executed.data_request: No actual ASDF, halo/tree/particle files are accessed or downloaded under this preregistration; a different data-access stage must be explicitly adopted first.

archived_results: One original mathematical counterexample and provider-readiness report, one independent Decimal/bisection proof and exact SHA negative control, permanent CI SHA manifest on audit branch after all tests pass. No real astrophysical halo data.
